name: SDO/HMI SHARP keyword constraints (documented definitions only)
notes: Only constraints that follow from the published definition of a keyword are listed. Verify each against the primary source before relying on it in a publication.
Definitions were checked against formulas reproduced from Bobra et al. 2014 (arXiv:1404.1879) in arXiv:1603.03775 (Table 1) and arXiv:2207.07254 (Table 2).
Deliberately NOT constrained: MEANJZH and MEANALP are signed quantities (no absolute value in their definitions) and negative values are common, so a sign rule would flag valid measurements.
No upper bounds are given for flux, helicity, current or energy keywords: no documented physical limit exists, and unusual large values are reported as statistical warnings, not as rule violations.

rules.basis: definition: total UNSIGNED flux (sum of |Bz| dA)
definition: H_c,total ~ sum |Bz . Jz| (sum of absolute values)
rules.description: total unsigned current helicity cannot be negative
rules.source: Bobra et al. 2014, arXiv:1404.1879; formula as in arXiv:1603.03775 Table 1

rules.basis: definition: sum of the MODULUS of the net current per polarity
rules.description: a sum of moduli cannot be negative
rules.source: Bobra et al. 2014, arXiv:1404.1879; formula as in arXiv:1603.03775 Table 1

rules.basis: definition: rho_tot ~ sum (B_obs - B_pot)^2 dA (a sum of squares)
rules.description: total photospheric free energy density proxy cannot be negative
rules.source: Bobra et al. 2014, arXiv:1404.1879; formula as in arXiv:1603.03775 Table 1

rules.basis: mathematical range of arccos in the definition (mean of arccos(B_obs.B_pot/|B_obs||B_pot|))
rules.description: a mean shear angle between two vectors lies in 0 to 180 degrees
rules.source: Bobra et al. 2014, arXiv:1404.1879; formula as in arXiv:1603.03775 Table 1

rules.basis: mathematical range of arctan in the definition (mean of arctan(Bh/Bz))
rules.description: a mean arctan angle lies within +/-90 degrees
rules.source: Bobra et al. 2014, arXiv:1404.1879; formula as in arXiv:1603.03775 Table 1
